deadline.value: Three rounds: April 15, September 15 and December 1. Next for Fall 2027: December 1, 2026 (year inferred).
deadline.quote: Deadlines: prior to April 15, September 15 or December 1.

gre_general.value: TOEFL and GRE are highly recommended documents in the application.
gre_general.quote: Highly recommended: TOEFL and GRE (or other certificates of language proficiency)

supervisor.value: You are admitted only once a PhD advisor agrees to accept you.
supervisor.quote: You will be admitted to the doctoral program if and when a PhD advisor has agreed to accept you as a student.

funding.value: Enrolment requires secure funding, so admitted students are funded (typically as salaried EPFL doctoral assistants).
funding.quote: The final enrollment in the doctoral program is conditional to the choice of a thesis topic, a supervisor and a secure funding.

also.quote: The basic starting salary of an EPFL doctoral assistant is CHF 55’225.- gross per annum

entry_route.value: Master's degree expected; only exceptionally a 4-year bachelor's with excellent grades.
entry_route.quote: Candidates who have obtained a Master degree or an equivalent title | Exceptionally, holders of a Bachelor degree (at least 4 years; excellent grades)

gre_subject.value: The program page does not mention a GRE Subject test.
